capabilities: delay loading of plugins on Obsidian startup
manage plugin enablement from Lazy Loader's settings page
disambiguation: It does not improve the performance of individual plugins; it only postpones when they load at startup.
extras: README warns the first install may need up to two Obsidian restarts to see the full speed increase, and that plugins must be disabled through Lazy Loader's own settings for the change to persist across restarts.
problem: Many installed community plugins slow Obsidian startup because they all load immediately when the app launches.
summary: Plugin manager that delays loading of other plugins at Obsidian startup to bring startup time under one second.
